non_blocking_findings.title: Prior review-governance artifacts were corrected non-destructively
non_blocking_findings.description: The branch history contains the earlier Independent Review artifact sequence, a revert that removed accidental Phase 08 review artifacts from main, and a governance-only merge restoring the corrected main baseline. The new material candidate subsequently passed the approved-phase ancestry and governance-baseline CI gate. This history is noteworthy but does not block the revalidated candidate.

non_blocking_findings.title: GitHub Actions Node.js deprecation warning
non_blocking_findings.description: Foundation CI completed successfully but emitted a warning that actions/checkout@v4 and astral-sh/setup-uv@v5 target deprecated Node.js 20 and are currently forced to run on Node.js 24. This is a maintenance item outside the Phase 08 functional blocker and does not affect the green result.

qa_blocker_revalidation.finding: The previous candidate loaded PaymentIntent through order.payment_intent and Fulfillment through order.fulfillments without independently applying the active Organization filter at those relationship boundaries.
qa_blocker_revalidation.fix: Commit 68fc86e950460ffae271965927ddd840b210173a removes implicit related-object loading from the workspace and queries PaymentIntent.objects.filter(organization=organization, order=order) and Fulfillment.objects.filter(organization=organization, order=order). Order remains independently scoped by organization and id, and Messages remain scoped by organization plus ORDER source identity.
qa_blocker_revalidation.adversarial_test: Commit b533ba4efde2e87467ea4975c14b4705805b2eb3 adds test_order_workspace_rejects_cross_organization_related_records. The test creates an Order in Organization A while creating PaymentIntent and Fulfillment records in Organization B that still reference that Order, then verifies the Organization A workspace returns neither cross-tenant child.
qa_blocker_revalidation.conclusion: The rework directly addresses the root cause of P08-QA-SEC-001 rather than relying on relational consistency assumptions. A fresh QA/Security checkpoint remains mandatory and was not executed in this session.

read_model_boundaries.summary: Dashboard remains a synchronous read-composition layer over canonical domains and creates no canonical business lifecycle or persistence model.

organization_filters.summary_and_attention_queues: All Orders, PaymentIntents, Fulfillments, Messages, IntegrationConnections and IntegrationDeliveries are selected with organization=organization before classification or rendering.

attention_queues.summary: Bounded operational queues continue to mirror canonical domain states and remain scoped by Organization. The P08-QA-SEC-001 rework did not alter queue classification or introduce dashboard-owned business rules.

workspace_composition.organization_and_order_filtering: CONFIRMED for both PaymentIntent and Fulfillment simultaneously.
workspace_composition.cross_tenant_order_behavior: Existing view test continues to require 404 when a user requests an Order belonging to another Organization.
workspace_composition.parallel_state: None. Workspace returns canonical Order, PaymentIntent, Fulfillment and Message records only.

authorization_and_isolation.authentication: dashboard_home and order_workspace remain decorated with @login_required.
authorization_and_isolation.active_organization: Organization is resolved through active_organization_for_user(user=request.user, session=request.session); no arbitrary request Organization identifier is accepted by dashboard views.
authorization_and_isolation.http_authorization_behavior: Cross-Organization Order workspace requests fail closed with HTTP 404.
authorization_and_isolation.relationship_isolation: PaymentIntent and Fulfillment now independently require matching active Organization and the already Organization-scoped Order.
authorization_and_isolation.qa_note: This is Independent Review evidence only. QA/Security must independently retest authorization and isolation before issuing GO/NO-GO.

privacy.summary: Order Workspace continues to render only operational identifiers, customer display/snapshot name, statuses, amounts, fulfillment display numbers, message purpose/status and channel display name. No raw provider payload, secret, credential, arbitrary integration metadata or public callback material was introduced by the rework.

read_only_and_side_effects.http_contract: Both dashboard views remain @require_GET; POST behavior remains HTTP 405 in direct tests.
read_only_and_side_effects.persistence: apps.dashboard still exposes zero persistence models and Phase 08 introduces no dashboard migrations.
read_only_and_side_effects.external_effects: No provider call, sandbox call, credential handling, public callback registration, deployment action or release behavior exists in the executable delta from the previous candidate.

performance_and_n_plus_one.recent_orders: Existing test_recent_orders_keeps_customer_reads_in_one_query remains present and verifies five recent Orders plus customer display reads execute in one query through select_related(customer).
performance_and_n_plus_one.workspace: The security fix replaces implicit related-object loading with explicit PaymentIntent and Fulfillment queries. This adds a fixed bounded number of queries for one workspace request but does not create a per-row N+1 pattern. Message channel remains select_related and all dashboard lists remain bounded by DASHBOARD_LIMIT=8 where applicable.
performance_and_n_plus_one.conclusion: No performance regression rising to a review blocker was identified.

risks.title: Synchronous dashboard read model
risks.description: Future data growth may require projection or caching work. Phase 08 intentionally keeps the dashboard derived and synchronous.

risks.title: Fixed query overhead introduced for stronger tenant isolation
risks.description: PaymentIntent and Fulfillment are now loaded through independent explicit queries. The cost is bounded per workspace request and is preferable to trusting cross-domain relation integrity for tenant isolation.

risks.title: Attention classification remains coupled to canonical domain states
risks.description: Future dashboard changes must continue to mirror canonical states rather than accumulating a separate dashboard workflow.

residual_risks: The Independent Review does not replace fresh adversarial QA/Security execution on b8eac30feafa8a41249e3f0af5e68e3c9159b4c1.
Workspace isolation relies on every future related boundary preserving explicit Organization scoping; regression tests should remain mandatory.
GitHub Actions dependencies should be refreshed before the Node.js deprecation warning becomes an execution failure.

checkpoint_recommendation.rationale: P08-QA-SEC-001 is materially corrected by explicit Organization+Order filtering on PaymentIntent and Fulfillment, backed by an adversarial inconsistent cross-tenant relation test. Existing authentication, GET-only behavior, privacy, bounded read patterns and no-persistence behavior remain intact. Foundation CI #173 is fully green on the exact new material SHA. No new blocking finding was identified.
checkpoint_recommendation.next_checkpoint: Fresh QA/Security on the same material candidate. Do not infer QA/Security GO from this Independent Review revalidation.
